note: The fixed topic list (#220), shared by every language. Ids are stable and never reused; a removed topic is retired, not renamed. Names are in the message catalogue (topics.name.<id>); `scope` says, in English, what belongs to a topic (for the people and agents who label words; never shown). Go: server/internal/topics (embeds a byte-for-byte copy, topics_test.go); web: lib/languages/topics.test.ts.
